concerns.text: Task T009b is marked 'FAILED: unspecified' in the comments, indicating the task description is incomplete or the dependency chain is broken. The spec requires FR-010 (SVD rank calculation) and FR-007 (correlation). Without a valid T009a producing `data/subspace_ranks.json`, T009b cannot execute, leaving FR-010 and FR-007 uncovered.

Task T016 (Quantization) is marked 'FAILED: unspecified' twice. It is critical for FR-002 (zero-shot quantization) and FR-005 (LPIPS on quantized outputs). The failure status implies the task logic is missing or the dependency on T007b-2 is unresolved, leaving the core experimental variable (INT8/INT4) unimplemented.

Tasks T010b (load FP16) and T014 (run FP16 generation) are unchecked and lack explicit implementation details in the 'Re-plan' notes. FR-001 (load adapter) and FR-003 (generate images) depend on these. If T010b/T014 are not fully specified, the baseline (US1) cannot be established, invalidating all subsequent comparisons.

Tasks T031a and T031b (CI timing and SC-005 verification) are unchecked. SC-005 requires measuring job duration against a 6-hour limit. Without these tasks, the plan cannot verify the feasibility constraint, leaving SC-005 uncovered.

Task T009a contains a comment 'Note: Run sequentially after validation to avoid OOM' but is marked [P] (parallel) in the header. While the text clarifies the constraint, the [P] tag is misleading and contradicts the 'Resource Constraints' section. This is a writing inconsistency that could cause execution errors.

Task T016 is marked [P] (parallel) but the 'Resource Constraints' section explicitly states it must run sequentially with T009a. The [P] tag is incorrect and creates a false parallel opportunity, risking OOM failures if the runner honors the tag.
